# VINASIG Design System

> A draft source of shared UI guidance for VINASIG websites, written for people and SI agents. All rules are proposals pending approval.

Start with the repository's `AGENTS.md` for agent instructions and project context. Read the source specification linked for the task. Do not assume draft rules are approved policy.

## Published guides

- [Overview](https://vinasig.github.io/web-design-system/) explains the purpose and current status.
- [Brand and logo](https://vinasig.github.io/web-design-system/brand/) describes logo variants, asset downloads, and draft usage recommendations.
- [Foundations](https://vinasig.github.io/web-design-system/foundations/) defines the draft visual direction and covers color, typography, spacing, responsive behavior, accessibility, and writing style.
- [Components](https://vinasig.github.io/web-design-system/components/) describes buttons, text inputs, status messages, and cards.
- [Patterns](https://vinasig.github.io/web-design-system/patterns/) covers forms, empty states, loading, errors, and page layout.
- [UI element library](https://vinasig.github.io/web-design-system/elements/) shows styled previews for all 81 entries in the NameThatUI snapshot, with 49 web entries and 32 macOS entries.
- [SI agent guide](https://vinasig.github.io/web-design-system/agents/) explains how an SI agent should use this system.
- [Shared working standard](https://github.com/VINASIG/agent-standards) provides reviewed snapshot imports and namespaced skills. A link alone does not import instructions.
- [SI agent UI quality workflow](https://github.com/VINASIG/web-design-system/blob/main/docs/agents/ui-quality.md) records the research-backed review checklist for generated interface work.

## Source files

- docs/elements/catalog.json defines the 81 entries. docs/elements/specimens.json supplies the rendered visual examples.
- `AGENTS.md` routes shared working rules and required local context. `docs/agents/project-guide.md` retains the complete project guide.
- `docs/agents/standards.md` records the snapshot integration and actual enforcement. `.vinasig/manifest.json` and `.vinasig/provenance.json` pin its payload and source commit.
- `docs/agents/ui-quality.md` documents failure patterns, a multi-stage UI workflow, and research sources.
- `docs/foundations/README.md` specifies the draft visual direction and foundations.
- `docs/brand/README.md` records logo source facts, file mapping, and draft usage guidance.
- `docs/components/README.md` specifies common interface components.
- `docs/patterns/README.md` specifies reusable page patterns.
- `src/styles/tokens.css` contains the implemented CSS design tokens.
